i.norm: The X5455 flags byte is read from the data buffer at the parse offset. Its bit 0 ({@link X5455_ExtendedTimestamp#MODIFY_TIME_BIT}) signals that a modify-time field follows, so parsing a buffer whose flags byte has bit 0 set must mark the modify time as present.

Buffer layout: parsing starts at offset 1, where the flags byte lives. Setting that byte to MODIFY_TIME_BIT (1) requests a modify timestamp; the four bytes that follow stay zero, encoding the timestamp itself.
